title: Tactics Ogre: The Knight of Lodis

info.about: Tactics Ogre: The Knight of Lodis is a tactical role-playing game developed by Quest Corporation and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy Advance (GBA). It was released in Japan in 2001, and in North America by Atlus USA in 2002.
info.why: Atlus's 2002 release has never been re-released or remade; the later PSP and Reborn games are remakes of Let Us Cling Together, not this one.
